fact: INTIC chairman Lourino Chemane said Mozambique has completed a thorough review of the Electronic Government Systems Interoperability Regulation, which sets standards for integrating and managing public information systems; the report is dated 2025-12-05 and gives no other date.
Ecofin Agency reports that Mozambique is currently revising the 2017 interoperability framework to strengthen technical standards, data-exchange governance, data protection and cybersecurity.
